title: Does anyone else do a side trip?
content: I have found myself hiking a bit and getting to some vantage points looking down upon some falling water. Many times it feels like a low water damn. I look down on fishes. Giant Carp like fishes. There is some natural wonder in the splendor of it all. It seems like the trek there is exhausting but once we’ve enjoyed the display, a somewhat busy thoroughfare suddenly appears and makes the hike seem obsolete and not even an afterthought. It’s like the entire journey is wiped away. Instantly and uncomfortably.
